Name: surface_material
Description: Specifies the surface type. Can pick from the following values: asphalt; concrete; gravel; grass; dirt; paved; unpaved; grass_paver; paving_stones. Select only one. where the surface material changes, begin a new zone.

Name: facility_name
Description: Common or formal name for zone. Example: Market Square, 21st St Promenade, Echo Park - west side
